# Font Awesome icons in phone-ui's fonts, beyond LVGL's symbols (LV_SYMBOL_*): one a
# line, its name and codepoint as Font Awesome's metadata/icons.yml gives them, then its
# style, solid (if left out), regular or brands, from Font Awesome 7 Free or Brands (the
# flake's FONTAWESOME), then, if turned, by how many degrees clockwise. gen-fonts.sh adds
# their glyphs to every ui_font_<size> and writes src/ui_symbols.h: UI_SYMBOL_<NAME>
# (UI_SYMBOL_<NAME>_REGULAR for regular, _<DEGREES> after that if turned), a UTF-8 string
# for a label, as LV_SYMBOL_* are. Regular ones move to U+F0000 + their codepoint, as they
# share Solid's; turned ones, brands ones and solid ones on a codepoint of LVGL's symbols
# (all are Font Awesome's: its glyph would replace LVGL's), to U+100000 onward.
#
# An icon Font Awesome Free lacks is ours: its name, then "svg" for symbols/<name>.svg (drawn
# as Font Awesome's: viewBox "0 0 WIDTH 512", filled in black), UI_SYMBOL_<NAME>, at
# U+100000 onward too.
#
# Icons: https://fontawesome.com/search?ic=free

tower-broadcast f519	# mobile data: the shade's tile
tower-cell e585	# the mobile network: the shade's row
sun f185	# brightness, bright: the shade's slider, Settings' slider's end
sun f185 regular	# brightness, dim: the shade's slider, Settings' slider's start
moon f186	# dark theme: the shade's tile, beside brightness
sim-card f7c4	# no SIM: the status bar, after the signal bars
lock f023	# SIM locked (PIN) or blocked (PUK): the status bar, after the signal bars
language f1ab	# Settings: the Language row
code f121	# Settings: the Developer mode row
bookmark f02e	# GitHub (apps/github): a repository bookmarked, its page's header
bookmark f02e regular	# GitHub (apps/github): a repository not bookmarked, its page's header
angles-left f100	# GitHub (apps/github): a list's first page, its bar of pages
angles-right f101	# GitHub (apps/github): a list's last page, its bar of pages
circle-check f058	# GitHub (apps/github): a check passed, in a list of pull requests and a pull request; Trilium (apps/trilium): a sync step done
circle-xmark f057	# GitHub (apps/github): a check failed
circle f111	# GitHub (apps/github): a check pending; Trilium (apps/trilium): a sync step to come
circle-minus f056	# GitHub (apps/github): a check skipped or cancelled
phone-slash f3dd	# missed calls not seen yet: the status bar, after the envelope
phone f095	# calling, answering: Phone, Contacts, Messages; home, About phone (LVGL's is Font Awesome 4's, mirrored)
phone f095 solid 135	# hanging up, declining: the call screen
usb f287 brands 270	# USB plugged into a host, upright: the status bar, left of Wi-Fi
clock f017	# Clock: its Clock page, the bar at the bottom
stopwatch f2f2	# Clock: its Stopwatch page, the bar at the bottom
hourglass-half f252	# Clock: its Timer page, the bar at the bottom
code-pull-request e13c	# GitHub (apps/github): a pull request open, draft or closed (its color says), its list's rows and its state
code-merge f387	# GitHub (apps/github): a pull request merged
circle-dot f192 regular	# GitHub (apps/github): an issue open; Trilium (apps/trilium): the sync step under way
circle-check f058 regular	# GitHub (apps/github): an issue closed as done
ban f05e	# GitHub (apps/github): an issue closed as not planned or a duplicate
ghost f6e2	# Telegram (apps/telegram): a deleted account's avatar, in the chat list
clock f017 regular	# Phone: its Recents page, the bar at the bottom
user f007	# Contacts: Phone's and Telegram's (apps/telegram) Contacts pages, the bar at the bottom
dialpad svg	# Phone: its Keypad page, the bar at the bottom (Free has no dial pad)
circle-info f05a	# Phone: a recent call's contact or new contact, the end of its row
star f005	# a favorite: Contacts (the button, the Favorites heading); a repository's stars: GitHub (apps/github)
star f005 regular	# not a favorite: Contacts, the button
divide f529	# Calculator: its division key
equals f52c	# Calculator: its equals key
xmark f00d	# Calculator: its multiplication key (LVGL's LV_SYMBOL_CLOSE is an older Font Awesome's, heavier than divide)
minus f068	# Calculator: its subtraction key (as xmark)
plus f067	# Calculator: its addition key (as xmark)
plus-minus e43c	# Calculator: its key changing the sign
percent f295	# Calculator: its percent key
bluetooth-b f294 brands	# Bluetooth on: the status bar, beside Wi-Fi (LVGL's LV_SYMBOL_BLUETOOTH is shorter than its neighbors)
bold f032	# the rich text editor's toolbar (Notes): bold
italic f033	# the rich text editor's toolbar (Notes): italic
underline f0cd	# the rich text editor's toolbar (Notes): underline
